newsitem.title: USA: BradyNet adds electronic mail directory service.
newsitem.headline: BradyNet adds electronic mail directory service.

text.p: BradyNet Inc, a Miami-based interactive online service, said it launched a directory of electronic mail addresses of emerging market participants with an embedded communication system.
Named "BradyNet Rolodex," viewers can click and send messages to individuals listed on the directory.
BradyNet started with a website in November 1995 to list Brady bond prices, ratings and commentaries. It added a discussion group, the FORUM, last month, said Roberto Krell, president of BradyNet.
The service is free of charge.
Starting in September, BradyNet will run advertising to make it a viable commercial venture, Krell said.
